This article compares the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial bleeding) among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (atrial fibrillation in Denmark), categorized by their anticoagulant treatment regimens. The data highlights how different treatments—or the lack thereof—correlate with bleeding risks during the reporting period [^src1].

When evaluating the treatment groups, patients receiving a combination of both [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan|marevan]] exhibit the highest rate of intracranial bleeding, with 1.50% (16 patients) developing the condition [^src1]. This is notably higher than the overall cohort average of 0.53% (733 patients) [^src1]. Patients treated exclusively with Marevan also show an elevated risk compared to the baseline, with a 0.82% incidence rate (53 patients) [^src1]. 

Conversely, the lowest incidence of intracranial bleeding is observed in patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, where only 0.45% (123 patients) experienced bleeding [^src1]. 

A notable anomaly in the dataset is the identical reporting for the "AK-behandling" (anticoagulant treatment) and "DOAC" categories. Both rows list exactly 101,674 patients without bleeding (99.47%) and 541 patients with bleeding (0.53%) [^src1]. This exact duplication suggests either a specific cohort definition where the AK-behandling group in this context consists entirely of DOAC users, or a reporting overlap in the source document. 

Because this comparison is drawn from a single dated section, no longitudinal trends regarding improvements or declines in bleeding rates across different treatments can be established.

## Table: AFDK_2024.pdf, p. 74

Rows compare: behandlingsgruppe · Columns show: antal-og-procentandel

| Behandlingsgruppe | Intrakraniel blødning Nej | Intrakraniel blødning Ja |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alle | 136357 99.47 | 733 0.53 |
| AK-behandling | 101674 99.47 | 541 0.53 |
| DOAC | 101674 99.47 | 541 0.53 |
| Marevan | 6422 99.18 | 53 0.82 |
| Både DOAC og Marevan | 1053 98.50 | 16 1.50 |
| Hverken DOAC eller Marevan | 27208 99.55 | 123 0.45 |

Entities: atrieflimren-i-danmark, intrakraniel-bloedning, doac, marevan

Summary: Tabellen viser antallet og procentdelen af prævalente atrieflimren-patienter, der udvikler intrakraniel blødning, fordelt på behandlingsgrupper (ingen behandling, DOAC, Marevan, kombination).
